environment.description: Same Spring Boot service deployed behind an internal NLB in a private subnet (10.128.0.0/20). The NLB target group has a preserve_client_ip attribute disabled, and the service's security group (sg-0a4f8e2c) ingress rules reference a prefix list (pl-0bf2e9a1c) that resolves to three internal CIDR ranges: 10.128.4.0/24 (monitoring), 10.128.8.0/23 (batch-processing VPC peering), and 172.16.200.0/28 (ops-bastion). The prefix list is managed by a separate CloudFormation stack (infra-network-controls-v3) with drift detection enabled and SNS alerting on modification. Additionally, VPC flow logs are enabled with a 1-minute aggregation interval to a locked S3 bucket with object lock (governance mode, 90-day retention). The NLB does not have a public-facing DNS record and is not associated with any internet gateway route.

config.network: Internal NLB in private subnet 10.128.0.0/20, no IGW route
config.prefix_list_management: CloudFormation stack infra-network-controls-v3 with drift detection
config.flow_logs: VPC flow logs to S3 with object lock governance mode 90d
config.dns: internal Route53 private hosted zone only
